subject: Is there a problem with gamlss  and zero inflated?

messages.subject: Is there a problem with gamlss  and zero inflated?
parts:

Maaslin.R taxonomy.pcl output -i taxonomy.read.config -F time -z

My R version is 3.2.3 with GAMLSS Version 4.3-6.


Maaslin appears to be running properly and giving reasonable results on this dataset without the -z flag. My best guess is that these versions of R and gamlss are too new and something broke ZI mode. Happy to provide any further information that is useful.


XCM
